cues.text: Let's set up hostels and rooms.
Open Hostel and Rooms, then press Add Hostel.
Enter the hostel name, choose Boys, Girls or Mixed, and set the capacity and a warden.
Press Add Hostel, and the hostel appears in the list.
Open the Rooms tab and choose the hostel.
Press Add Room. Enter the room number, the floor and the capacity, and choose the room type.
Press Add Room again. The room shows its capacity and how many beds are taken.
